The title was derived from a Queensbridge individual named Illmatic Ice, with “illmatic” being an adjective used to describe something extraordinary. Illmatic had an all-star lineup of East Coast producers; Large Professor, DJ Premier, Pete Rock, Q-Tip, and L.E.S. to provide the boom bap backdrop for Nas to display his “N.Y. State of Mind.” At 20 years old, Nas was praised for his storytelling and flow as he talked about life growing up in the Queensbridge projects.

This album is Nas' most controversial in his entire catalogue, mostly down to its original title. Whilst various celebrities and thousands of fans defended the album's title, Nas was not allowed to release it under that name and was forced to change it to a self-titled/untitled album.
